assembly_doctrine.astronomical_layer: The existing Moira local-solar-day resolver determines the sunrise-to-next-sunrise window, topocentric sunrise/sunset half, and local-mean-solar weekday.
assembly_doctrine.source_layer: The caller supplies the 1879 profile's Purva or Amara source label; the existing source-owned nominal schedule remains unchanged.
assembly_doctrine.composition_rule: Select the existing nominal schedule using caller-supplied paksha plus astronomically derived half and weekday.
assembly_doctrine.boundary_rule: Day is sunrise inclusive to sunset exclusive; night is sunset inclusive to next sunrise exclusive.
assembly_doctrine.polar_policy: Fail explicitly when lawful sunrise/sunset bounds do not exist.
assembly_doctrine.materialization_rule: Do not convert nominal nazhigai offsets into event instants and do not claim a current schedule cell.

authority_and_provenance.solar_geometry: existing configured-reader-backed topocentric -0.833 degree solar-altitude crossing
authority_and_provenance.time_scale: UT1 for resolved solar-event Julian Days
authority_and_provenance.weekday: local mean solar time at the governing sunrise, Sunday zero through Saturday six
authority_and_provenance.evidence_class: composition invariants and regression coverage over the established local-solar boundary

validation_evidence.scope: astronomical local-solar sunrise and sunset boundary only; does not validate the historical Pancha Pakshi doctrine
validation_evidence.fixture_hash_canonicalization: UTF-8 text with CRLF and CR normalized to LF before hashing
validation_evidence.comparison_semantics: Moira topocentric -0.833 degree UT1 solar-event Julian Days against the Horizons-derived fixture's -0.8333 degree UT labels

public_claim: Given an explicit profile, UT1 instant, location, and caller-supplied Purva or Amara source label, resolve the governing local-solar day, day/night half, local-mean-solar weekday, and corresponding unchanged nominal 1879 schedule.
public_nonclaims: astronomical or lunar inference of Purva or Amara paksha
conversion of nominal nazhigai offsets to Julian Days or datetimes
a current Pancha Pakshi activity or schedule cell
solar-proportional or seasonal scaling of nominal durations
condition evaluation, scoring, or electional window search
cross-witness normalization or corroborated public status
a universal or default Pancha Pakshi canon

artifact_distribution_boundary.policy_effect: The standing non-bundling architecture remains unchanged; this additive modern policy requires no new source artifact or rights-clearance phase.
